name: agent-swarm
description: Orchestration skill: make the current session a controller that hands tasks to persistent Codex/Claude worker agents, waits for their replies, and reviews and commits their work.

interface.shortDescription: Hand tasks to persistent Codex/Claude worker agents
interface.longDescription: Make the current session an orchestrator: split work into bounded tasks, hand them to persistent Codex and Claude workers that keep their context between tasks, wait for their replies, and review and commit their work.
defaultPrompt: Use agent-swarm. Act as the orchestrator: split the task into bounded worker prompts, hand them to workers with agent-swarm run, wait for them, review and commit their work, and report running/completed/blocked agents plus required user action.
